Repeated 2696.09-2699.53 highs in bars 114/116/119 plus inside bars and shrinking ranges (17.82 in bar 120) show neither side gaining acceptance, so Always-In is two-sided.
transition_conditions: Bull resolution: a close above 2804.59 with the next bar holding above it would reassert the bull trend toward and beyond 2850.
Bear resolution: a close below 2633.31 that is not reversed, and then below 2568.16, would break the bull's higher-low sequence and shift the read from pullback to trading range/top.
A close above 2740.42 (bar 118 high) with follow-through would be the first bull breakout from the current 13-bar range.
Continued overlapping bars inside 2633.31-2740.42 keep the range phase and leave the structure a candidate bull flag until a boundary breaks.
